item.title: Can telcos pass NTC’s proposed internet speed requirements?
item.description: What you need to know: The NTC proposes mandatory minimum average speed of 50Mbps for both downloads and uploads for all telco providers. item.title: 2026 will make or break affordable phone brands
item.description: What you need to know: Skyrocketing RAM and storage costs in 2026 are forcing smartphone prices up and hitting budget-friendly brands the hardest.
